Job Title: Backend Developer

Job ID: BD/BACK/JULY 26

Company: AKOVA FINTECH SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD.

Location: 18 Rabindra Sarani, Poddar Court Building, Gate No: 3, 3rd Floor, Room No: N,

Kolkata - 700001

Salary: Competitive, based on experience

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Backend Developer to build, deploy, and maintain scalable backend systems for:

1. Digital Payment Applications

2. GPS Tracking Device Software

Key Responsibilities

1. Backend Development

Design and develop RESTful APIs (or GraphQL) for mobile/web apps.
Build secure payment processing systems (like UPI, wallet, transactions).


Implement real-time GPS tracking (WebSockets, MQTT, or similar).

Handle user authentication (OAuth, JWT, 2FA).
Optimize databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, etc.) with indexing , caching.
Ensure low-latency, high-availability systems.

2. Cloud s Hosting Management

Deploy and manage backend on AWS/Azure/GCP.
Configure CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).
Set up load balancing, auto-scaling, and monitoring.
Manage domain, SSL, and security policies.

3. Security s Compliance

OAuth2.0, JWT, token-based authentication
Implement PCI-DSS compliance (for payments).
Secure APIs against SQLi, XSS, CSRF, DDoS.
Data encryption (AES, RSA) and secure key management for sensitive info.

4. Collaboration

Work with frontend team for API integration.
Document APIs (Swagger/Postman).
Debug production issues and optimize performance.



5. Experience

1 - 4 years experience is needed in the same field

Preferred Technical Skills Required

Languages: Node.js/Python/Java

Frameworks: Express.js/Django/Spring Boot

Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis

APIs: REST, WebSockets, GraphQL

Cloud: AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS), Firebase, Docker, Kubernetes

Payments: Stripe/Razorpay/UPI integration, PCI-DSS experience GPS Tracking: MQTT, WebSockets, GIS tools

Good-to-Have Skills

Experience in fintech or GPS tracking domains.
Familiarity with IoT protocols (if GPS devices need backend support).

How to Apply:

Send your CV to rajashree.auddy@akova.in or call 9147067841 for more details.
